$comment: Review triggers (QBC-36, the Review row of spec section 6.1; NIST SSDF SP 800-218 PW.7, OWASP SAMM design and implementation review). Plugin defaults: a project replaces any domain in .brick-harness/review-triggers.json (P8). The program judges them on the item's whole diff (bhreview.triggers), never an agent (P3). python_apis: modules a changed Python file imports on either side of the diff, read by Python's own parser (ast); a name also covers its submodules. sql_dcl: a changed SQL statement holding a DCL keyword (GRANT, REVOKE) as sqlparse classifies it. owners: CODEOWNERS owners whose paths carry the domain; this is the semantics no parser sees, so only the project declares it. tiers: packet tiers that get the check (the duplication row of QBC-19).
